purpose: Teach: めど/取組み/先着/借入金/略称/一級/推察/親密

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、半年でめどをつけられた
lines.en: Your father set the business on solid footing within the first half-year.
lines.style: Quiet, measured recollection. Each phrase lands with gentle weight. Slight pause between thoughts—not rushed, like he's seeing it again. Warm but distant, the warmth of memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは現場の取組みを大切にされた
lines.en: Yes. He always valued what happened on the ground, in the real work.
lines.style: Steady, affirming tone. Respectful but not ceremonial. Direct eye contact through the words. A son speaking his understanding plainly, without embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お客様、先着で表彰されたぞ
lines.en: Your father was recognized by customers right from the start—that mattered to him.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic. A slight lift in the middle, like he's still a little proud. Trails off gently at the end—not sad, but carrying the weight of years passed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは借入金を計画的に返されました
lines.en: Yes. He repaid every loan exactly as he'd planned. Not a day late.
lines.style: Calm, steady voice. Speaks with quiet certainty—these are facts he knows bone-deep. Respectful rhythm, like someone laying stones carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社名の略称を考案されたぞ
lines.en: Your father came up with the company's abbreviation himself—clever man.
lines.style: Gentle, almost private smile in the voice. A small, proud detail emerging. Tender at the edges, like he's sharing something only family would know.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは一級技能者を育成されました
lines.en: Yes. He had the gift of bringing out the best in craftsmen. Made them want to be better.
lines.style: Warm conviction. Not lecturing—sharing. The voice settles into each phrase. There's admiration here, and the relief of understanding someone fully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、取引先のお気持ちを的確に推察されたぞ
lines.en: Your father could read what a partner needed before they even said it. Remarkable instinct.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation. Thoughtful pace. A small, knowing pause before the last phrase—like he's still a little amazed by it. Tender, the voice of someone who watched and learned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員と親密な絆を築かれました
lines.en: Yes. He built a deep trust with everyone who worked beside him. That was his real legacy.
lines.style: Firm but gentle. The words carry finality—a conclusion reached after long thought. Respectful, almost ceremonial, but grounded in genuine feeling, not performance.
